list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade), with PSN progress counts from PSNProfiles. 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden.

gtasix.label: GTA 6 Trophy List — GTA Six Insider

outputlag.label: GTA 6 Trophy List — Output Lag (launch-day guide)

psnprofiles.label: Official trophy list and PSN counts — PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Plan on a long road: reviews put the story near 60 hours and the full list near 200 hours (Planet GTA 6, citing VGC and Push Square). No trophy in the list needs online play.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the final cutscene (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Both characters become playable in this chapter, which opens up most of the rest of the list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Watch for the time-sensitive race against Yago in this chapter if you are working on Strangers & Freaks (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Bank vault robberies open near the end of this chapter, so the robbery trophies start here (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back (Output Lag).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, at Vice City International Airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts (Output Lag). It is the biggest single grind: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations are among its lines (Output Lag).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count (Output Lag). Keep going to 300: 100% completion needs 300 (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSN tracks the count to 9. Any one try counts — you do not need to win or finish first.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Output Lag's guide reports two shooting ranges holding 42 gold medals between them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. PSN tracks the count to 14; winning at least one race at each location is what counts.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different race events count; winning the same race twice does not add to the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests against Cal — win one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits (Output Lag).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies (Output Lag). Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand is time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 race against Yago carries an hourglass icon, so save first, then race (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, disappears once that chapter ends (Output Lag, reporting PowerPyx). After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — then follow her to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task (Output Lag). It is not confirmed the trophy strictly needs that one spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops (Output Lag). Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PSN tracks the count to 3 — finish three full sets of cards found around Leonida.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. PSN tracks the count to 100 — open the WAiNK app at 100 different spots around Leonida.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play (Output Lag).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area (Output Lag). Escaping a bank vault job with your partner also earns it — vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks (Output Lag). The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive (Output Lag). 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming — and an assault rifle works well against a group of gang enemies; adrenaline extends Focus (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work, planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count — go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed and pops after you fly about 1 km from the airport (Output Lag). Save first: the police come fast (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map (Output Lag). Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code inside, open the safe and leave unseen (Output Lag). Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target (Output Lag). If someone spots you, reload rather than push on (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open; you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner (Output Lag). 100% completion needs all 8 vaults (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone (Output Lag).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 52 areas — visit every one of the 52 areas on the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. PSN tracks the count to 9; 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The official description is all the list says — no step beyond the drink and the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's frontage and out the other side. The official description is all the list says — the showroom and the smash are the whole trophy.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police (Output Lag). If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal: Jason and Lucia both reaching maximum Strength should pop it. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind (Output Lag). PSN tracks the count to 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The official description is cryptic by design — this is the plain reading of it: fail at something, then get it right the second time.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. The official description is cryptic by design — this reads as a rare or unexplained event found while exploring, so keep an eye out for the odd while you roam.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down while driving past and striking with a melee weapon. The official description is all the list says — the drive-by and the melee hit are the whole trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars (Output Lag).
trophies.name: On the Spot
